// Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
// Synthetic characterization of unchanged MIT-licensed AZQR inventory calculations.
package region

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/models"
	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/scanners/plugins/region/types"
)

type inventoryCaptureTripwire struct{}

func (inventoryCaptureTripwire) RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	panic("unexpected HTTP during pure inventory characterization")
}

func inventoryCapturePanics(call func()) (panicked bool) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			panicked = true
		}
	}()
	call()
	return false
}

func TestRegionInventoryCalculationCapture(t *testing.T) {
	http.DefaultClient = &http.Client{Transport: inventoryCaptureTripwire{}}
	http.DefaultTransport = inventoryCaptureTripwire{}
	dir := os.Getenv("REGION_INVENTORY_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Fatal("explicit capture output directory required")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	const one = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
	const two = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
	const lower = "abcdefab-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
	const upper = "ABCDEFAB-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
	resource := func(sub, kind, location, sku string, n int) *models.Resource {
		return &models.Resource{ID: fmt.Sprintf("/subscriptions/%s/resourceGroups/rg/providers/%s/r%d", sub, kind, n), SubscriptionID: sub, ResourceGroup: "rg", Type: kind, Location: location, Name: fmt.Sprintf("r%d", n), SkuName: sku, SkuCapacity: 2}
	}
	resources := []*models.Resource{
		resource(one, "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines", " East US ", "Standard_D4s_v3", 1),
		resource(one, "MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/virtualMachines", "East US", "Standard_D4s_v3", 2),
		resource(one, "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachineScaleSets", "West Europe", "Standard_D4s_v3", 3),
		resource(one, "Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks", "eastus", "", 4),
		resource(two, "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines", "East US", "Standard_F4s_v2", 5),
		resource(two, "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines", "global", "", 6),
		resource(one, "Microsoft.Custom/widgets", "", "=Widget", 7),
		resource(upper, "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines", "North Europe", "Standard_D4s_v3", 8),
		resource(one, "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines", "East\tUS", "standard_d4s_v3", 9),
		resource(one, "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines", "EUROPE", " Standard_D4s_v3 ", 10),
	}
	selectors := []string{one, two, lower, upper, "33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"}
	regions := []string{"East US", " East US ", "East\tUS", "East\nUS", "east-us", "EASTUS", "East\u00a0US", "east\u212aus", "", "unassigned", "global", "GLOBAL", "europe", "unitedstates", "asia", "asiapacific", "australia", "brazil", "canada", "france", "germany", "india", "japan", "korea", "norway", "southafrica", "switzerland", "uae", "uk", "private-region"}
	inputs := map[string]any{"resources": resources, "selectors": selectors, "regions": regions}
	scanner := &RegionSelectorScanner{}
	outputs := map[string]any{}
	for i, sub := range selectors {
		outputs[fmt.Sprintf("build-selected-%d", i)] = scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(sub, resources)
	}
	outputs["build-nil"] = scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, nil)
	outputs["build-empty"] = scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, []*models.Resource{})
	merged := scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, nil)
	mergeInventory(merged, scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, resources))
	mergeInventory(merged, scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(two, resources))
	outputs["merge-selected"] = merged
	repeated := scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, nil)
	mergeInventory(repeated, scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, resources))
	mergeInventory(repeated, scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, resources))
	outputs["merge-repeated"] = repeated
	empty := scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, nil)
	mergeInventory(empty, scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, nil))
	outputs["merge-empty"] = empty
	outputs["build-nil-resource-panics"] = inventoryCapturePanics(func() {
		scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, []*models.Resource{nil})
	})
	outputs["merge-nil-source-panics"] = inventoryCapturePanics(func() {
		mergeInventory(scanner.buildInventoryForSubscription(one, nil), nil)
	})
	normalized := []map[string]any{}
	for _, region := range regions {
		normalized = append(normalized, map[string]any{"region": region, "normalized": types.NormalizeRegionName(region), "physical": types.IsPhysicalRegion(region)})
	}
	outputs["normalization"] = normalized
	for name, value := range map[string]any{"source-inventory-inputs.json": inputs, "source-inventory-outputs.json": outputs} {
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("Captured %d inventory calculation branches and %d literal normalization/predicate cases; no Scan, credential or service client invoked", len(outputs), len(regions))
}
